Container.Name: Duplicacy-Exporter
Container.Overview: Prometheus exporter for Duplicacy backups. Collect real-time backup progress from logs or receive Duplicacy Web UI reports by webhook, with persistent metrics and an optional storage poller.
Container.Description:
Duplicacy Exporter exposes Duplicacy backup metrics for Prometheus and Grafana.
FEATURES: - Real-time backup speed, progress, and chunk metrics in log-tail mode - Post-run backup summaries from logs or Duplicacy Web UI webhooks - Backup and prune health metrics - Persistent completed-backup metrics across container restarts - Optional Duplicacy storage-size and revision poller - Grafana dashboard 25089
DEFAULT SETUP - WEBHOOK MODE: 1. Start the container with the default Mode set to webhook. 2. In Duplicacy Web UI, set report_url to: http://<unraid-ip>:9750/webhook 3. Configure Prometheus to scrape: http://<unraid-ip>:9750/metrics
LOG FILE MODE: 1. Set Mode to log_tail. 2. Select the host directory containing the Duplicacy log for Duplicacy Logs Directory. 3. Keep Log File set to /logs/duplicacy.log, or change it to the correct path inside /logs. 4. Set Machine Name and, for stock Duplicacy CLI logs without metadata, Snapshot ID.
DOCKER LOG MODE: To tail another container directly, set Mode to log_tail, clear Log File, select /var/run/docker.sock for Docker Socket, and set Duplicacy Container Name exactly. Mounting the Docker socket gives the exporter highly privileged access to the Docker daemon; shared log-file mode is safer and recommended by the upstream project.
PERSISTENCE: The Data Directory stores the last completed backup, storage, and prune values so metrics remain available after an exporter restart or image upgrade.
OPTIONAL STORAGE POLLER: The poller runs Duplicacy list/check commands against initialized repositories. It requires repository mappings and storage credentials, and remote checks can be slow or costly. Leave it disabled unless storage-size and revision metrics are required.
Container.Changes: ###v1.0.0 (2026-09-19) - Initial Unraid template release. - Supports webhook, shared log-file, and optional Docker log-tail modes. - Adds persistent metric state and optional storage-poller configuration.

Config.Name: Metrics / Webhook Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for /metrics, /health, and the webhook endpoint.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent exporter state and last-seen log timestamp.

Config.Name: Duplicacy Logs Directory
Config.Description: Optional host directory containing the Duplicacy log. Required when Mode is log_tail and Log File is used.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Optional Docker socket for direct container-log tailing. Clear Log File when using this. WARNING: Docker socket access is highly privileged.

Config.Name: Poller Repositories Directory
Config.Description: Optional parent directory containing initialized Duplicacy repositories used by the storage poller. Reference child paths under /repos in Poller Repositories JSON.

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: Collection mode: webhook receives Duplicacy Web UI reports; log_tail parses a shared log file or Docker container logs.

Config.Name: Machine Name
Config.Description: Machine label fallback. Required in log_tail mode unless the log provides a machine name.

Config.Name: Log File
Config.Description: Log path inside the container for shared log-file mode. Clear this field to tail Docker container logs instead.

Config.Name: Duplicacy Container Name
Config.Description: Exact name of the Duplicacy container to tail when Mode is log_tail, Log File is empty, and the Docker socket is mounted.

Config.Name: Snapshot ID
Config.Description: Optional snapshot label for stock Duplicacy CLI logs that do not contain section headers or DUPLICACY_META.

Config.Name: Webhook Path
Config.Description: HTTP path that receives Duplicacy Web UI report_url POST requests.

Config.Name: Storage Host Map
Config.Description: Optional JSON object mapping storage hostnames or IP addresses to friendly labels, for example {"192.168.1.20":"nas"}.

Config.Name: Tailscale Domain
Config.Description: Optional Tailscale domain suffix to remove from storage host labels, for example example.ts.net.

Config.Name: Replay Hours
Config.Description: Hours of Docker log history to replay when direct Docker log tailing starts.

Config.Name: Maximum Log Buffer
Config.Description: Maximum partial Docker log buffer size in bytes before incomplete data is discarded.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.

Config.Name: Persist Metrics
Config.Description: Persist the last completed backup, storage, and prune values so they survive restarts.

Config.Name: State File
Config.Description: Metric-state file inside the container. Keep this under the mapped Data Directory.

Config.Name: Persistence Interval
Config.Description: Seconds between changed-state snapshots.

Config.Name: Enable Storage Poller
Config.Description: Enable Duplicacy list/check polling for storage-size and revision metrics. Requires initialized repositories and credentials.

Config.Name: Poller Repositories
Config.Description: JSON list of repositories, for example [{"path":"/repos/photos","storage":"default","snapshot_id":"photos"}].

Config.Name: Poller Interval
Config.Description: Seconds between storage-poller cycles. The default is 24 hours.

Config.Name: Poller Timeout
Config.Description: Per-command timeout in seconds for Duplicacy list and check operations.

Config.Name: Duplicacy Binary
Config.Description: Duplicacy executable used by the storage poller. The upstream image bundles this binary.
